story_type: fishing boat fire, crew abandons ship to a life raft
hook: Their fishing boat caught fire in the Bering Sea.
narration: This fishing boat was on fire in the Bering Sea, sixty nine miles west of Adak, Alaska.
Her five crew had already abandoned ship into a life raft.
They had set off their emergency beacon, and help was coming.
A beacon like that sends its position by satellite, so rescuers know exactly where to look.
A Coast Guard aircrew from Kodiak found the smoke, and the Coast Guard called on any ship nearby to help.
The fishing vessel Aleutian Beauty answered and headed for the raft.
[short pause] The raft rose and fell in the swells as she came close.
Then the fishermen climbed off the raft and onto her deck.
outcome: All five fishermen were rescued from the life raft, uninjured.
title: Fishing boat burning in the Bering Sea
description:
On Oct. 20, 2013, five fishermen abandoned the burning fishing vessel Western Venture into a life raft 69 miles west of Adak, Alaska, and were picked up uninjured by the good Samaritan vessel Aleutian Beauty.
